head: 552123c81a314570a3a9104c5a7bbf00131fcb10
classification_reasons: Blast radius is docs-only but large: 111 files, three independent full-document splits (NOTES, DECISIONS, PROGRESS) plus four live-doc link updates, and this change already needed two gate iterations and a fix round (sandbox-masked .env park) before reaching phase (d).

No automated test exists for the split's own correctness (index completeness, citation resolution, text fidelity): plan.md itself says this is 'evidence collected by hand in phase (c)/(d), not a pytest name', so the third routine condition (code the existing tests already cover) does not hold.

Spec is tight on paper (no open concern; all five draft questions settled with the owner in PR #86) but the requirement set is intricate (per-file frontmatter rules, number-only naming, ordering rules for three separate indexes), which is the opposite of a small, mechanical diff.
attempted: Intent: compared the split against intent.md's proposed outcome (docs/notes, docs/decisions, docs/progress with indexes, stubs for NOTES/DECISIONS, PROGRESS keeping only the current record, four live docs repointed) — the diff implements exactly this, nothing nearby substituted.

Spec and plan: verified docs/notes/index.md (32 files, ascending order, original headings), docs/decisions/index.md (26 files, ascending order), docs/progress/index.md (21 archived records, study record correctly placed between sessions 12 and 13, later non-session records appended per the build-time re-derivation plan.md calls for); checked decision 18/21's amended_by relationship and byte-for-byte text fidelity (choice 126) against docs/decisions/18.md; checked docs/NOTES.md and docs/DECISIONS.md stubs resolve; checked docs/OPERATING_MODEL.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, README.md, HANDOFF.md edits repoint to the new indexes as plan.md's order of work specifies. One real gap found and independently confirmed in the diff (not just the verifier's claim): spec.md requires docs/notes/<N>.md's `verified_with` to carry 'Claude Code version, plugin version, runner', but of 32 files only 2 add a plugin version and none names a runner at all (e.g. docs/notes/12.md has only `verified_with: "plugin 0.2.10"`, missing the Claude Code version). This is a real, literal shortfall against a stated Requirement — but it is frontmatter metadata nothing parses today (spec.md Design: 'read by nothing today'), is not listed in spec.md's Acceptance section or Flagged concerns, and under REVIEW.md's definition ('Important' = would break behavior, leak data or breach a policy; style/completeness gaps are nits) it does not clear the bar for escalation on its own.

Proof: gate-c.json (not a runner record I cited as proof, read only to see the prior gate's recorded checks) shows commands green with `ran_by: runner` and `1391 passed`; this phase's own test.log/build.log/lint.log correctly carry the `deferred to the runner` first line, which per the brief is the expected placeholder in a CI session, not a missing or false claim; verifier.md's exercised checks (index-vs-disk counts, stub resolution, link grep, frontmatter spot checks) match what I independently re-derived from the diff and the working tree.

Blast radius: grepped the diff for `plugin/`, `template/`, `tests/`, `.claude/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `REVIEW.md`, `sdlc.yaml` paths — no matches; confirmed no risk_list item (auth, migrations, money, production config) is touched; confirmed plugin/ files that cite `docs/NOTES.md section N` / `decision N` in comments and an error string are untouched and still resolve through the stubs.

Policies: security-baseline/data-conventions — no secret or personal data moved, text is pre-existing platform facts/decisions/session records; ux-conventions does not apply (no UI); definition-of-done — build/test/lint unaffected by a docs-only diff, consistent with plan.md's Proof section.

Tests: this is a docs-only change; no test file is touched, added or weakened; nothing in `tests/` reads these docs today (confirmed by grep), so no bug could hide behind an unchanged or weakened test.
